text:
oncall-bot: P1 ALERT — hosted-api (eu-west-1) 502 spike. Aggregated error rate = 18% over 2m, latency p95 up 3x. Paging primary oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-31415 :rotating_light:\nchris: acked. I'm primary for this shift, currently on call. I'll gather scope and start mitigation.
chris: quick assessment — appears to start ~15:02 UTC, a rise in 502s from frontend -> inference-proxy. No obvious deploys in last hour per deploy-bot.
maria: I'm incoming for the next shift, will be on deck in ~8m. If this persists at handoff we should swap ownership cleanly.
lee: assigning comms early — I can be comms owner if you want to focus on runbook steps, @chris.
chris: yep please take comms, @lee. I will drive triage and mitigation.
lee: comms owner here. I'll open a consolidated blurb for support and update status page. initial customer impact: intermittent 502s for text generation requests in eu-west-1, estimated <5% of total traffic but affects high-rate customers. drafting message now.
chris: runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/inference-502.md. first steps: 1) confirm proxies with `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=inference-proxy` 2) check proxy logs for 5xx 3) validate backend pool (dedicated pools + fallback routing). I'll start with proxies.
chris: (run) ```\nkubectl -n infra logs deployment/inference-proxy --since=10m | grep \"HTTP/1.1\\\" 502\" | head -n 50\n``` 
chris: proxy logs show timeouts calling model-runtime on a subset of pods — local qps heavy and a few K/V cache misses spiking.
maria: note for handoff: if the KV cache is the issue, there's a known mitigation to hot-warm the prefix cache (runbook step 4). Also consider temporary routing to dedicated pool with lower latency.
lee: status page draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates (502) impacting text-generation in eu-west-1. A small portion of requests may experience failures or retries. Engineers are actively mitigating." :writing_hand:\nlee: pinging #support to surface to CS — @support-bot please push to support triage.
support-bot: Support notification posted to #support. Ticket created: SUP-92211. Priority: High. Include any customer-facing notes to append.
chris: mitigation attempt 1: scaled inference-proxy from 6 -> 12 replicas and toggled network retries to conservative settings. Monitoring for 2m.
chris: started a controlled fallback for the heaviest route to the dedicated pool (route: /v1/generate -> dedicated-eu). This is on a canary config so we can revert quickly.
maria: +1 on the dedicated pool test. If latency improves and error rate drops, we should keep fallback until upstream patch.
lee: comms update to customers sent (short). I'll add link to status and note we're rolling a fallback to reduce failed requests.
chris: 2m after scale, aggregated error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% and p95 latency back to 1.3x. Not fully resolved but improvement. Continuing to monitor.
maria: I'm 2m out. If this stays at ~6% by handoff, I can take over as primary and continue verification and follow-up patching. Also will coordinate with runtime team for KV cache diagnostics.
chris: agreed. Handoff plan: I'll document current steps in thread, list mitigations toggled, and mark `driving: maria`, `comms: lee` at handoff_ts=1795550475. Also adding postmortem stub to link later.
chris: toggles done: scaled proxies=12; network_retries=3; canary_route=dedicated-eu=true; logging increased on runtime. Todo for incoming: validate cache hit rate, follow runtime traces, consider restarting 2 problematic runtime pods if traces show hung requests.
lee: comms: open CS note updated with workaround and ETA for next update in 30m. If you want, I can remain comms owner for next hour while you dig deeper, @maria.
maria: yes please, keep comms, @lee. I'll take driving. chris — I'm taking over now.
maria: taking ownership (driving). chris handing off: confirmed mitigations, monitoring, and exact commands in runbook. Last check: error rate 6%, trending down.
chris: handing over — oncall handoff complete. If anything escalates, I'm available on pager and DM.
lee: acknowledged handoff. comms owner continues.
oncall-bot: handoff recorded: previous_primary=chris, new_primary=maria, comms=lee, thread=1795550110. Handoff window: 8m after initial page. :white_check_mark:
maria: next steps (for post-handoff): 1) validate KV cache hit ratio and warm keys 2) run `kubectl rollout status` on model-runtime after safe restarts 3) coordinate with storage team if backend persistence is implicated 4) open a short RCA ticket and include logs/link to this thread.
maria: posting final note to status page in 15m with next update. taking full ownership.\n
